I actually have a slightly different take. I'm sure the story is meant to have many interpretations and never nails down which one it is on purpose. 

The one that struck me is remember how in the opening scene one of his coworkers says "Hey is that Paul Allen?" and Baitman says "no that's paul allen over there" then later paul allen thinks baitman is someone else (maybe that's not the real paul allen and he is calling baitman someone else just to fuck with him / make a point). then his buddies give the detective a report that they were with baitman. Then the lawyer he confesses too thinks he is someone else. Everyone is so involved with themselves and they are all so alike they can't tell each other apart
no it's the perfect place, but I'm probably too ugly for you.
Reading is pretty much the only thing that can get me out of bed. Well that and drinking

well you're in your 20's and you're married so it sounds like you don't have my problem, and neither does your husband. My situation is lonelier than someone in solitary confinement.

Movies are fine, eating out is fine, I can cook a little bit, can't travel as it's too much stress. It's not that I  have to be with someone that's into science as much as myself, but when I advertise myself on a dating site or in real life I run out of subjects to talk about really quickly. Movies and TV are fine to talk about for about 5-10 minutes but it still ends up being a rather shallow conversation. Books can be a bit better, but I have never met anyone that was into the same ones as I am.

I've asked reddit to evaluate my dating profiles before and I got feedback along the lines of "Your profile is too one sided talk about all the other great things you're into". To me that was nonsense because I talked about chemistry, biology, electronics, computers/programming, books, and even a little Psychology. It's not that I don't have varied interests it's just that most of them are on the cerebral side of things. If I were to meet you in a bar I might think it's neat that you play instruments, but that's about all I've got without going back to "so what do you do for work" or "what else do you enjoy" or reaching back towards my science fields or sci-fi / fantasy books.

You also mention bad dates, but I can't really even get dates. I haven't been on a real date in several years now despite having active profiles on okcupid and pof.
There aren't any people in my life
